svg.aria-label: Load-shedding street: one building for each of the last 42 nights in Dhaka. Lit windows mean I contributed on GitHub that day; dark flats mean I didn't. Lights on 17 of 42 nights, longest run 6, brightest night 01 Nov with 23 contributions, 1 release night with fireworks. Shops run along the ground floor with flats above, open and lit on IPS through the load shedding. The shops have Bangla signboards: Allah'r Daan Biryani House, Mamar Cha Stall, Bhai Bhai Pharmacy, Priyo Library & Stationery, Bismillah Auto Repairs, Mayer Doa Store, Madina Sweets, Abbas Auto Repair, New Modern Tailors. Each shop looks like itself: degs and tables at the biryani house, shelves of medicine at the pharmacy, a library with a glass door, a departmental store with a glass front and aisles, garages full of tools, a glass case of sweets, and a tailor's with mannequins. The cha stall never closes; it runs on a hurricane lantern. Also: crows on the electric wires, laundry drying on the roofs, a mosque behind, and on the street just a green CNG and a cycle rickshaw with a painted hood.
